name: Mercado Central (Central Market)
subtitle: The historic municipal market hall in the Baixa, the city centre.

facts.label: Role in the city
facts.value: A 2011 architecture dissertation (University of Pretoria) says it was the only infrastructure provided for the city's micro-traders, and that informal street markets had spread north of it.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Baixa district; corner of Avenida 25 de Setembro and Rua do Mesquita (as given in dissertation).

facts.label: Vendors in 2026
facts.value: Fish vendors barred from Praça 25 de Junho say the market has no space or fish storage for them.

parts.text: The historic municipal market hall in the Baixa, the city centre. A 2011 university dissertation describes it as the only infrastructure provided to support the city's small traders.
